# ChoiceGrid

A grid-based selection component that supports both radio buttons and checkboxes. Displays rows and columns with interactive selection elements.

**Import:** `import { ChoiceGrid } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/ChoiceGrid.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/ChoiceGrid.stories.jsx` — Overview, Variants, Layout, InteractionStates, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/ChoiceGrid.mdx`
